title: Thickness of protective coverings.
officialText:
The thickness of fire-resistant materials required for protection of struc-
tural members shall be not less than set forth in Table 720.1(1), except as modified in this section. The figures shown
shall be the net thickness of the protecting materials and shall not include any hollow space in back of the protection.
